name: Mérida (Spain)
description: Red field charged at the centre with the yellow Roman gate of the city from the arms of Mérida, a wall with two arched gates between two round towers beneath a crenellated arch.
history: The symbols of the city of Mérida are the flag and the arms, blazoned as gules, the Roman gate of the city or: a wall with T-shaped merlons and two arched open gates between two tall round crenellated towers, behind which sits an arch crowned with seven merlons.

features.role: Roman gate of the city: wall with two arched gates between two round towers beneath a crenellated arch
